{{Top|leg}}
Modular plating was designed as a light-weight substitute for more cumbersome armor. '''Modular plating Mark I''' was used primarily for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in diplomatic situations where discretion was more important than defense.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
